newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Jade Technologies sees lower 1997 pre-tax profits.
newsitem.headline: Jade Technologies sees lower 1997 pre-tax profits.

text.p: Jade Technolgies said on Wednesday it expected pre-tax profits for the 1997 financial year ending September 30 to be lower than in the previous year.
According to the company's prospectus for its Singapore IPO, the lower pre-tax profit would be due to lower net interest income and absence of any foreign exchange gains.
It said, however, that the company's directors believed turnover would grow in the 1997 financial year.
Company officials declined to comment on the projections for net profits for 1997.
The company's pre-tax in 1996 was S$2.57 million on turnover of S$24.95 million.
